sessions.name: Amy
messages: Chatting with you is so fun
Just a bit sleepy, gotta work tomorrow
Good night, don't reply to me
Not yet, just got out of the shower
Nothing, just wanted to ask what you're doing
It bit my charging cable in half 😂
Dunno, but now I laugh every time I see it
Cats are all like that, my roommate's cat scratches the sofa every day
Already gave up on saving it
Then I'll get up early too to keep you company
Ugh, even if I can't, I have to
Forget it, you should sleep in 😜
There was a kid in the ward today
Cried the whole time getting the shot
After crying, he even said thank you to me
Yeah, suddenly not so tired anymore hehe
When you're tired, think of me
By the way, what did you have for dinner?
Hehe, what do you want to eat?
Ordered takeout, remember to grab it
What time do you get off tonight
Then go home early and rest after work 😂
Yes yes, my mom's nagging genes
By the way, are you free this weekend
Wanna go out, haven't gone out in ages
Sure, I'll hang with you this weekend
Not bad, spent all afternoon revising the proposal
The client changed the requirements again
Ugh, that's how it is for all of us workers
Will you always treat me well
Why ask all of a sudden 😳
It's so late, I'm gonna sleep first 🤔
Do you have to get up early tomorrow morning too
So we can sleep in then
Maybe slept too much during the day
What's there to talk about me, someone who gets tortured by clients every day
So tired today, my back can't even straighten
Jason, let me tell you something
Just now a parent insisted on giving their kid the injection themselves
In the end the director stopped it
Ugh, there's all kinds of people
Then what time can you leave
Ugh, then I'll eat dinner first, not waiting for you
My roommate made it, tomato beef brisket
Your roommate's cooking is pretty good huh
Of course, I totally rely on her to feed me😎
Thanks for your hard work bro
Where are we going this weekend?
Sure, where do you wanna go?
Wanna get hot pot after shopping?
By the way, has Momo been good lately?
Today it clawed my curtains again
I'm starting to think I'm raising a monkey
Send a funny pic of it
Just got stepped on by Momo
What time did it step on you?
What time to meet this afternoon? 😎
My legs are about to fall off from all the walking
Let's go let's go, I'm starving
Me too, too stuffed to move
Okay, next time I'll take you to that new place
Thanks for keeping me company today
What are you talking about, of course
Go to sleep early, what shift do you have tomorrow
This baby just got off the night shift
Aren't you gonna ask if I'm tired today
There was a kid who kept crying during the injection, poked three times
Then hurry up and sleep, stop scrolling on your phone
By the way, was Momo good today
Was busy just now, it knocked my pen off the desk three times today
I'll order you something good tonight
Less sugar, no ice, don't forget
Had cafeteria food at lunch, so gross
I suspect the chef has it out for me
Our department got a new intern today 😜
Hands shake even more than mine
Watching them give the kid an injection made my heart ache
You should show them the ropes
How dare I? I'm a mess myself
And a bowl of spicy hot pot, no cilantro
How did you know I wanted that?
Here, it's here, smells so good
Oh no, then rest early today
Dry it before sleeping, don't catch a cold again
Still revising proposals, eyes are blurry
Then sleep early, don't stay up
I'm on night shift tomorrow, sleeping during the day, don't bother me
Feel like I slept all day
Haha, perfect, you can work all night
Don't remind me, just thinking about it makes me sleepy
Hang in there, I'll send you a red packet for coffee
No need, hospital coffee tastes awful
Just chat with me for a bit
The ward is super quiet today
You think you can slack off on night shift?
Gotta run the moment the bell rings
Finally can sit for a bit
Just saw this, you're about to get off work, right?
Gonna crash as soon as I get home
Night shifts are like that, used to it
By the way, any plans for the weekend? 🤔
Haven't decided, will let you know then
I need to study, don't disturb
Books for the title exam, headache
Then good luck, I won't bother you
Once I'm awake I can't fall back asleep, sigh
Just do it, you're free anyway
What kind of talk is that
My roommate brought her boyfriend back yesterday 😏
They were watching a movie in the living room, loud
But I want something good to eat.
Hehe, then I won't hold back.
I'll show you when it arrives.
By the way, you pick the place for hot pot this weekend.
Okay, I'll see if there's a new place.
It has to be tasty, don't fool me.
Want to watch a movie tonight.
No, I'm scared alone in the room.
LMAO, that part was so funny.
I told you this movie was good, right?
Yeah yeah, want to watch again tomorrow.
We agreed to go for hot pot today.
Then hurry up, I'm all ready.
I'll wait for you at the subway entrance.
You said you wanted to eat everything.
You never look at it seriously
I am serious, it really looks good
Then I'll give it a try
If you like it just buy it
No need, I can buy it myself
Just can't bear to spend it 😶
Then let's look at something else
Walked so much today, my feet hurt
Less sugar, no ice, I remember
Next time let's go eat at that new place
You paid today, I'm keeping track
Haha, that's how it should be
Just finished showering, so happy today
Thanks for what, I'm happy too
Don't even wanna move on the weekend
Hang in there a bit, noon will be over soon
Today a parent kept asking questions
Asked until I didn't even know how to answer
I'm gonna sleep early, work again tomorrow
Go ahead, don't stay up late
It's Monday and I feel like a noodle
I just got off the night shift 😶
Can't sleep, my brain is still spinning
Then I'll count sheep for you
Actually feeling a bit sleepy now
Go to sleep, go to sleep
Just finished a meeting, my head is buzzing
What time is it, you slept till noon
Order takeout, what do you want?
I don't know, you help me look
Congee? You just got over a cold
No, I'm sick of drinking it
Momo was lying on the windowsill all morning
I want to pet the cat
Depends, I have a shift the day after tomorrow
A bunch of crappy requirements this afternoon
Client changed it to the eighth version
In the end, the first version will definitely look the best
Don't say that, I'm really afraid of this
I have to go to night shift again tonight 😶
You just transferred and already night shift
Ate, just grabbed a couple of bites 😂
I'm working overtime, probably late today
Fed, fed, he eats better than me
Calmed down, gave him a sticker
Get some rest early, don't push yourself
Just fell asleep not long ago😶
Alright alright, you sleep, I won't disturb you
Let me know when you're awake
Not bad, a bit better than yesterday
By the way, have you read that book for your title exam
Don't mention it, I get sleepy as soon as I flip it open
Being sleepy is right, means you're sleepy
Want to read together tonight? I'll keep you company
You keep me company reading, won't you fall asleep again
Okay, I'll trust you this once
What's this book about? I don't get it
Aren't I here to keep you company
I'll go take a shower first
I'm going to sleep, day shift tomorrow🤔
Day shift is great, normal schedule
Tell me about it, night shifts make you stupid
Meeting this morning, I'll be lurking
A new intern came to the department today
The head nurse asked me to, annoying
Mentoring is great, makes you look senior
What did you have for lunch
Yeah, I'll pick you up after work
You just got over a cold, can you handle spicy?
Alright, split pot, you get mild spicy
That intern grabbed the wrong meds
I caught it and stopped it
Scared me to death, my legs went weak
Drink some hot water to calm down
Almost there, waiting for you at the entrance
You're one to talk, you ate a ton too
I was just showing you support
So full I can't sit down
Thanks for treating me to hotpot
Sleep early, don't stay up late again
Yeah, slept straight through till dawn
Nice weather today, hung out the blankets to dry
I'll help you dry your pillow, haha
Gotta review a ton of images this afternoon
My eyes are gonna go blind😳
Done reviewing, might have to work overtime a bit
What, the intern causing trouble again?
No, just my legs hurt from standing all day
Go soak your feet when you get back
Then I'll buy you some foot soak packs
Still working overtime, you home yet?
You go be busy, don't worry about me
Grabbed a couple buns on the way to tide me over
I'll bring you some food tomorrow
I'll buy it! Who said I'd cook
Why'd you stay up late again yesterday
The moment I lie down I'm wide awake
I'll catch up on the weekend
Foot soak packs arrived, remember to pick them up
Okay, I'll have my roommate grab them
Where's your roommate? Haven't heard you mention her lately
She's dating someone recently, never home
Scared of what, I'm not a kid
Then sleep in nice and late
Sleep till noon, nobody stop me
Asked how I've been, and whether I have a boyfriend
I'm going to sleep, talk tomorrow
Weekend, thought about where to go?
Just woke up. Sleeping in feels so good.
What are you up to today?
Want to go shopping. Haven't been out in ages.
Let me get ready. Meet at noon?
Okay, usual spot at the subway entrance.
I see you. You're dressed like a student 🤭
This milk tea is so good.
Less sugar, no ice. Got it.
Hehe, you have a good memory.
I'm tired from walking. Let's find a place to sit.
There's a shop over there. Looks nice.
I had so much fun today.
Let's hang out more on weekends.
It only thinks about canned food.
That new place, let's eat there next time.
Do I look like someone who forgets?
Walked so much today, my legs are sore.
Go to bed early. I'll come see you tomorrow.
Lying in bed, don't want to move.
Same. Momo just lay on my keyboard.
Four days in a row. Ugh.
Feel sorry for you for a second.
Are you ever going to fix that computer?
You said the same thing last week
This week for sure, I swear
Go to bed early, stop scrolling on your phone
The food at the cafeteria today was so bad
I just slacked off and ordered some spicy hot pot
A kid with a fever came to the pediatric ward today, crying so loud the whole floor could hear
It's okay, once I coaxed him he behaved
Oh right, the one you bought
Does it feel good after soaking?
Of course, I have good taste 😎
Momo shed a ton of fur today
I feel like I'm gonna be buried in cat hair
Morning, I'm on the day shift again today
Just finished a meeting, so sleepy
What did you have for lunch today?
I'm working overtime today, might be late
Go eat quickly, don't push yourself
Got home, cooked a bowl of noodles
The schedule came out today, I start night shifts again next Wednesday
Even if I can't, I have to
By the way, the books I ordered for review arrived
Just looking at it gives me a headache
Take it slow, read a little every day
I'll read with you and supervise you
You can't even remember things yourself, and you're gonna supervise me
You hit the nail on the head
What did you have for lunch?
The noodle place downstairs, the usual
That's the only place still edible
There was a really fierce parent today
The kid wouldn't get the shot, and the parent blamed me
They can blame you for that too?
Said I didn't coax the kid properly
Thankfully the head nurse spoke up for me
The head nurse is a good person
I'll treat you to something nice this weekend
My roommate brought her boyfriend back today
Didn't even want to stay in the living room
Then I'll keep you company remotely
Just took it, it's lying on my lap
Then I'll kiss it through the screen 😜
I'm sleepy, gonna nap for a bit
Go ahead, I'll read a bit more
I forgot all the basic nursing stuff
Don't stay up too late, you have work tomorrow
Morning, I read until 1 last night
Bought a rice ball downstairs at the hospital
Then take the chance to read a bit
Why do you sound like my mom
Can't help it, once I start I can't stop
Then I'll come find you this weekend
Oh right, my computer still won't turn on
We'll fix it together this weekend, I'll bring tools
Last day of day shift today, off tomorrow!
Then I can sleep in tomorrow
For sure, anyone wakes me and I'll fight them
I just saw a new hotpot place
Good reviews, wanna go this weekend?
A super cute kid came in today
Kept holding my hand and wouldn't let go
Haha, you're such a people person
So you're in a good mood today
What time should I come find you tomorrow
Afternoon, I'm gonna sleep like the dead in the morning
Oh right, bring your computer tools
I got it, I got it, don't worry
I heard you say that last time too
I'm reading, stop texting me so much
Hey, there's a concept I don't get
Do you know anything about nursing
No, but just ask, I'll look it up with you
Never mind, I'll look it up myself
What time did you study till
I'm seeing you tomorrow, gotta save up my energy
Hehe, so am I more important or the exam
But I don't wanna get up
Sleep, sleep, I'm not coming to find you till 2
You sleep a bit more too
Gonna wash my hair and get ready
I'm getting ready to head out and eat too
Just grabbing something, saving my appetite for hotpot tonight
Take it slow on the way
That outfit you're wearing looks pretty nice
Let me take a look at the computer first
No big deal, it's a system thing
That's great, I have so much stuff in there
Just need to reinstall, I'll try my best to save your data
Once you fix it I'll buy you bubble tea
All your files are there, go check
One compliment and you're already flying high
Let's go, I'll treat you to bubble tea
By the way, that female colleague of yours
The one from the last team dinner
Your casual asking is kinda scary
Have a snack first, don't starve yourself
Look at the menu, order whatever
I feel like I gained three pounds
I just got home too, Momo is waiting at the door
It gets better treatment than me
For the computer, and for keeping me company
I'm going to sleep, walked so much today
By the way, I'm on night shift next week, don't disturb me during the day
Momo just stepped on me and woke me up
Where did it step on you?
It literally plopped its butt right on my nose
So did you pour it some food?
Feed the cat first then yourself, very conscious
I'm off today, planning to sleep all day
I still have to revise a proposal today
Then you revise, I'm gonna go lie down
Slept all the way till past 2😏
That was a good sleep huh
Did you finish revising your proposal?
Wanna come out for a walk, change your mind?
But didn't I say I'd go shopping with you this weekend?
Then let's go out, I'll treat you to milk tea
See you at the subway station at 4
Let's go to that place again next time
Nothing, just wanted to say goodnight.
The chubby-faced cat is sunbathing on the windowsill again.
I'm on day shift today, just left home.
The food at the cafeteria today is indescribable.
What weird dish is it this time?
The eggplant is cooked to mush.
What are you laughing at? Come eat it yourself.
By the way, let me tell you something.
Starting next week, I'm on three night shifts in a row.
I'll have to catch up on sleep during the day 😎
Then I won't disturb you during the day.
Yeah, if you message me and I don't reply, don't overthink it.
During night shifts, sleep well, I won't bother you.
I also need to start studying for the title exam, my head hurts.
I'll keep you company, ask me if you don't understand.
A little kid cried heartbreakingly during an injection.
And then his mom was even more nervous than him.
You should've seen it, her hands were shaking.
Gotta go, still a bunch of forms to fill out.
Did you remember to leave a note?
Yeah, otherwise I'd have to pick it out for ages
My roommate got a pothos in the living room, says it purifies the air
Pothos are really easy to keep
This fourth one, I doubt it
Get her something easy to care for
I said cactus, but she thinks it's too prickly
You too, don't stay up late revising the proposal
I open my title book to page two and I wanna sleep
What are you laughing at, it's hard
Which subject is hard to memorize?
Then memorize in chunks, don't cram it all at once
Then go do your thing, I'll study
Okay, call me if you have questions
Even if it's quick, eat well
Oh no, I almost dropped my phone in the water
Put it on the edge of the sink while washing hands, slipped
Your typing speed is no joke
Gotta be, trained from saving patients
Dead tired today, like a dog
Yeah, night shift starts tomorrow, kinda nervous
Nervous about what, you're a veteran
Three in a row, scared I can't handle it
If you can't handle it, lean on me, spiritually
I'm serious, sleep well during the day, message me when you wake up
I'm gonna sleep early, night shift tomorrow
Don't message me too early tomorrow, okay
Ugh, still revising the proposal till now
Going to sleep, good luck tomorrow
Mid night shift, secretly slacking off
Hospital hallway is so quiet, just me in the duty room
Saw what you sent in the middle of the night
Didn't you sleep a bit then
Just got off night shift, dead tired
Yeah, gonna sleep after a shower😏
Didn't sleep well, too bright during the day
Got one, it's just my brain won't stop
So what time do you start work tonight
Lie down and rest a bit more now
Yeah, lying down scrolling my phone
Oh right, you remember my birthday next week🤔
Of course I remember, how could I forget
So how are you planning to celebrate for me
If I tell you, it's not a surprise anymore
Then I'll look forward to it
The third patient had an emergency, been busy till now
Didn't even have time to eat
Then hurry up and eat something
No appetite but you still have to eat, otherwise you can't keep going
Got it, I'll buy some bread later
Yeah, had a couple bites of bread
Really can't eat, don't force me
Okay okay, won't force you, then drink more water
Feels like I can't hold on
Just one more day to get through
Never mind, feels better after saying it
I'm going to get busy, still have inspections
I'm off work, it's already light out
Go back and sleep, don't worry about me
Then let me know when you wake up
This baby just finished the night shift, tired as a dog
A kid had a fever and cried all night
Order takeout, I'll order for you 😳
Yeah yeah, you go do your thing
I don't have much going on today, just gonna draw at home
LMAO even the cat knows how to lounge better than me
Go to sleep, sleep, call me when you wake up
Just woke up, head still a bit dizzy
Probably low blood sugar, eat something sweet
Hot pot right after waking up, your stomach
Let's have hot pot on Sunday
Oh right, my phone's almost dead, gotta go 😳
My proposal got rejected by the boss today
Editing until I want to smash my computer
Ugh, bosses are all like that
I'm on night shift tonight too
Alright, then sleep well during the day
I'm at the office, just finished editing
Thanks for your hard work, I just finished a round here
A kid in the ward had a seizure, my hands are still shaking
Handled it, the doctor came too
I'm okay, just a bit shaken
Take a deep breath, you definitely did nothing wrong
If something had happened on my shift, I'd feel guilty forever
Don't overthink, you reacted in time on the spot
Hugs, hurry up and finish so you can go lie down
Still three hours till shift change
Hehe, don't forget to turn off the lights
Today's shift felt like a century
Just woke up, just saw this
Oh right, my roommate said the landlord is raising rent next month
I'm thinking maybe just move when the lease is up
Then you gotta check the market first
I'm in a meeting, you order first
Hahaha, that's how it should be
Eat less, we still have dinner tonight
No no no, I mean if you eat too much you won't have room for dinner
I read two pages of my exam prep and got sleepy
That's still good, take it slow
There's still a long time till the exam
Yeah, but don't leave it to the last minute
Slept all day, just woke up and pawed at my feet
LOL, the cat lives better than me
I wanna live a cat's life too 😯
Go to bed early, I have day shift tomorrow 😗
Okay, you get some rest too.
Heading out, subway is super crowded today.
I just got to the department 😎
So many patients today, it's insane.
Can you even grab lunch at noon?
Just shoved down a couple bites.
One parent kept asking questions, my food got cold.
Rough. If it's cold, don't eat it.
Would be a waste to toss it, I finished it.
Only been twice, don't praise me.
I still have to study tonight.
Go ahead, I won't bother you.
Read ten pages, rewarded myself with a variety show.
Alright, as long as you're happy.
That new variety show is hilarious.
The one with actors teaming up, I can never remember the name.
Sleepy, going to bed. Good night.
Morning, I just took over shift.
There was a super cute kid today who kept calling me 'big sister'.
Hahaha, you must be floating on air.
Our team had another review meeting today.
I feel the proposal still needs more changes.
Just change it, you can handle it.
Can't you comfort me a bit?
Okay okay, Zhou Yuan is the best, go go!
Damn, just got yelled at by a parent.
Saying our queue is too slow.
I'm fine, just a bit aggrieved.
Don't take it to heart, they're anxious.
I know, just feeling bad right now.
Let's get something good to eat when we get back tonight.
That parent who yelled at me earlier came back to apologize.
Said the kid's fever broke, but he was in a bad mood.
See, they can still be reasonable.
Phew, I feel so much better now.
I might get scheduled for two night shifts next week.
Gotta handle it. Nurses are all like this.
Don't push yourself too hard. If you can't, talk to the head nurse.
It's fine, I'm used to it.
Off work now, not working overtime today.
Whoa, the sun must be rising in the west.
Just for today, don't jinx it 🤭
So what are you doing tonight?
Going home to pet the cat and cook.
I still have to work until eight tonight.
Want me to save you some food? Bring it to you tomorrow.
Then I want that thing you made last time.
Hurry home, wash up and sleep.
By the way, are you free to look at apartments this weekend?
Great, I've listed a few, I'll send them to you later.
My mom called today, asked if I have a partner.
I said, seeing someone, not official yet.
Nothing, just feel like you haven't told your family yet.
Go to bed early, good night
Ugh, I really do care a bit
I'll talk to my parents, give me some time
Morning, got the potatoes packed for you
I'll heat them up for lunch
If it's cold remember to heat it all the way through
Just got through a busy wave
The parents today were all easy to deal with, good mood
That's good, hope you don't run into the mean ones again
Just ate the potatoes you made, so good!
Ah, did I put too much salt?
Just a little, no big deal
Zhou Yuan, my night shifts are scheduled for next week
Tuesday's night shift ends Wednesday morning
So I pick you up Wednesday morning?
Really no need, taking the bus is super convenient
Alright then, call me if anything
My roommate brought her boyfriend back today
The living room is full of people, I'm too embarrassed to go out
Hahaha then hide in your room
That's why I want to move out ASAP
Check out places this weekend, if it's good just lock it in
Yeah, budget's limited, gotta be picky
How about considering a shared place closer by 🤭
I AM sharing, I want a single room
Ugh I know, just looking for now
Off work, wanna head home early today
I'm on day shift today, almost done too
By the way, are you free Saturday?
I wanna go shopping, buy some summer clothes
Hehe, then I'm gonna shop for a long time
Let me tell you, I weighed myself today
I said two pounds is nothing, you can't even tell
Really. Though your weight in my heart did get heavier
By the way, I still haven't bought all the books on my reading list for next week's exam
Which one are you missing? I'll buy it for you
No no, I'll order it myself
Okay, buy it early then, don't procrastinate
Yeah yeah, I'll buy it tomorrow
I'm sleepy, gotta get up early tomorrow
Awake awake, Momo just stepped on my face
It's just greedy, there's still food in the bowl
Cats are all like that. The family member from our department brought their cat in for a shot yesterday, it kept meowing
So tragic. Why don't you give Momo a shot too
Off today, this baby's gonna sleep till noon
Sleep sleep, I'll order you brunch
Hehe, no need, I'll get up at eleven 😎
Was just busy, edited a photo
How far have you gotten in that title exam book
The one I read last time, already at page fifty 🤭
Come on, you haven't even read it
Roommate made porridge, snagged a bowl
So nice, I want some too
It takes me an hour to get there, the porridge would be cold
What are you doing this afternoon
No plans, just lounging at home 😋
How about you come over, help me look at my computer, it keeps lagging
Okay~ perfect, I didn't finish fixing yours last time
Grab two milk teas on the way
Less sugar, no ice, got it
You're the best, fixed it in ten minutes
It's just that it has too much bloatware, I deleted a bunch
From now on you're my official computer repair guy
But no cilantro in the hotpot, okay?
Got it, I'll order a separate portion for you
Who says? I think you look great
Really, when have I ever lied to you 😜
By the way, are we going to look at apartments next Sunday?
Yeah, your lease is up next month, right?
My roommate said she wants to move too, so let's look together
That works, three people sharing saves money
Would you think I'm too slow at finding a place?
No, with your shift work, where would you find the energy?
I'm already home, what's there to be careful about?
Sleepy, thanks for coming over today
No need to be polite with me
Guess I just woke up naturally
Lazy around at home again today?
I want to go to the supermarket this afternoon, no groceries at home
This yogurt is buy one get one free 😏
If you can't finish, give it to me
Look, they're selling cat treats over there
Get some for Momo, she's been good lately
Had a great time shopping today
Then next time you carry the stuff
My mom called again nagging me, saying I'm out here alone and don't know how to take care of myself
Yeah, she even asked if I have a boyfriend
No, just thinking about when's a good time to tell her
Wait till it's more stable, if my mom finds out she'll ask every day
Getting up to go to work
I'm working today too, let's do our best together
The food at the cafeteria is so bad today
Haha just make do, eat more tonight to make up for it 😋
This afternoon a little kid needed a blood draw and cried so hard my heart broke
Yeah, gave him a sticker and he stopped crying
What do you wanna eat tonight, I'll order for you
Ordered some congee, good for the stomach 😋
I'm on day shift tomorrow, night shift the day after
Okay, remember to get enough sleep before night shift 😜
Remember to eat after you're done
I've only read a few pages of that title certificate book
The exam is next month, I'm afraid I won't pass
You've been working overtime these days, when do you have time to study
Which day off this week? Let's focus on studying
House viewing on Sunday, nothing else that day
Then after house viewing on Sunday, I'll accompany you to study 😏
I can't, but I can hand you water
Sleep early tonight, night shift tomorrow
Yeah, I'll lie down at eight
Close your eyes and count sheep
Sure, I'll leave after you count to a hundred
Night shift today, catch up on sleep during the day
It's okay, chat a bit before sleep
Is it because your socks stink?
Alright, I'm going to sleep, see you tonight
Go to sleep, be careful at work tonight
Okay, don't reply if you're busy
Then what do you suggest I drink
I'm so sleepy I can't stand it
I did, but still can't hold on
Then lean against the wall and doze for five minutes
Almost, just a few more hours until off work
Thanks for your hard work, go home and get some good sleep
Slept six hours, feel alive again
Not too bad, had a meeting this morning
What did I do in your dream?
Dreamed you treated me to hot pot
Hehe, so let's have hot pot tonight
Sure, I'll head over after work
I'm almost there, you grab a table first
Already got one, by the window
My mom called again, asking if I'm coming back this weekend
So you're going back to Hangzhou?
I said I have stuff this week, next week we'll look at apartments
Then you go back once, I'll look at apartments myself
No, I want to look with you
Then what do we tell your mom? 😋
We'll figure it out later, she'll forget in a couple days 🤔

Just woke up, Mom knocked my pillow onto the floor.
Haha, cats are harder to raise than kids.
Buddy, I'm chasing sales targets, need a favor.
Does your company do exhibition booths?
I mean, do you know anyone who does?
Let me think... there's a supplier, Lao Chen.
But he's pretty slick, so be prepared.
As long as he can get things done, I'm not picky.
My son wakes up at 3 AM sharp every day, like clockwork.
So are you still drinking? You might not be able to wake up at night.
Haven't drunk, I've been sober for three days.
Actually, today makes it the fourth day.
Impressive, can you make it to the weekend?
My wife says I'm fat, waistline went back three centimeters 🤦
Lao Chen is a good guy, just talks too much.
He gave three proposals for one booth.
Did you see the high school group chat?
Lao Zhao got divorced, posted a long message in the group.
Want to go fishing this weekend?
I'm in Shanghai, you go fish by yourself.
Fine, I'll go alone and space out.
Sent you the logo draft, take a look.
The milk tea shop one, even though it didn't open, I thought we could tweak it and still use it.
Alright, let me take a look.
This font is too thin, it'll blur when printed on the cup.
And the color scheme is too pink, you think milk tea is lipstick?
Haha, my wife picked that color.
I'll revise a version for you, get it to you before the weekend.
It's for you to have blessings, not to enjoy them.
Oh honey, the way you asked that 👌
By the way, the hotel for the 100-day banquet is booked 🤦
Noon on the 9th, over at Laomendong.
Alright, I've taken leave, I'll be there on time.
Dress well, my wife has a lot of relatives coming.
How have you been lately? You seem quiet.
Find a partner, don't just feed the cat.
Momo is less trouble than a partner.
My brother asked me for money again, said for rent 👌
I've revised the logo, take a look at this version.
I stayed up over the weekend to revise it, don't waste my effort.
Not bad, this color is right.
But didn't the milk tea shop not open? Where are you using it?
I want to make a mini-program, sell some coffee and snacks, side hustle.
Last time you were serious too.
Last time a friend screwed me over, this time it's just me.
Alright, think it through first, don't rope people into partnership again 🤦
I know, I'll do it alone, small scale.
If you're free this weekend, come to Nanjing and I'll treat you to a meal.
I said I'll go on the 9th, don't rush me.
I mean come earlier, let's have a drink 😆
My wife is sleeping here tonight, I'm sleeping in the living room.
Small thing, about taking care of the kid.
Is she making him sleep on the couch?
I'm sleeping on the couch, don't get it mixed up.
Had a few drinks tonight, boring alone.
Reminds me of high school when we climbed the wall to get BBQ.
Let's video drink another day, I'll keep you company.
It's settled then, don't forget again.
That boss from the milk tea shop contacted me again.
Said he wants to try again, asked for the logo.
Let me sort it out, I'll send it to him in a couple days
Don't drag it to next year again
That logo, can you make me a square one too
Good bro, I'll buy you a drink later🍺
Gotta take him for his vaccine tomorrow
My wife's working, I'm taking him alone
Gotta handle it even if I can't🤦
Two hours in line, two hours crying
How many days you staying this time you're back
Just one day, leaving at night
Then let's grab duck blood vermicelli before you go
That place in Laomendong, you used to love it
Depends on time, if I can make it I'll eat
My brother might come to Shanghai next month
You got any work over there to hook him up with
What's his education, what can he do
Associate degree, sold houses before, decent talker
I'll ask around, can't promise anything
Took a lot of photos yesterday, huh
Pick a few later, I'll help you edit them
That'd be great, you edit better than me
End of the month, still short a chunk
Boss is watching us every day, so annoying
Yeah, asked all the relatives, lost all my face asking😂
I don't have money either, don't look at me
The 100-day banquet is tomorrow, what time you getting here
High-speed rail, arriving Nanjing South at 11
Alright, I'll have my brother pick you up
Your brother, the one who wants money?
That's the one, he's on the way🤦

sessions.name: Mom
messages: Yeah Mom, just got off work
Been up ages, Momo stepped on my face at 6
That cat's more reliable than an alarm clock
[link] Drink this glass of water on an empty stomach in the morning, cleans your gut and nourishes your stomach
Mom, I drink coffee in the morning
Haven't decided yet, might just cook some noodles
At that hotel in Hexi, the setup was so grand
When are you gonna give me something to worry about too
When your dad was 28 you could already walk
We're wearing jackets here in Nanjing, is it cold in Shanghai?
Not too bad, it's hot in the office
[link] Five mistakes middle-aged and elderly people make when doing square dancing
Look at this, Old Li from our team hurt his knee dancing
Son, when was your last checkup?
Heard there's flu going around Shanghai recently
Remember to wear a mask when you go out
Really not, I do wear a mask
[link] Flu season, eat these things regularly
Your favorite when you were little
What good stuff are you making?
Just like your dad, can't even fry an egg without burning it
By the way, is that pothos on your balcony still there?
Yeah, alive and well, just a few yellow leaves
Did you water it too often?
Water less, wait until it's completely dry
Your dad went fishing this afternoon, I'm home alone
I'll find time to come back next week
Son, you said you'd come back next week, what date?
Not sure yet, let me check my schedule
Okay, let me know once it's set, I'll buy groceries
Your dad caught three crucian carps, I've salted them
He's grinning from ear to ear
Son, have you set the date for coming back next week?
Mom, there's a project going live this week, I can't get away
Being alone in Shanghai, eat well
[link] You can't just make do with meals when eating alone, nutrition needs to keep up
Son, that project you mentioned last time, is it done?
By the way, your dad's blood pressure seems a bit high lately
Go to the hospital and get it checked
He finds it troublesome, I can't persuade him
Wait a bit, I haven't washed my face
Why wash your face, Mom doesn't mind
No way, I actually gained two pounds on the scale
Isn't it time for a haircut?
Cut it shorter, look more energetic
Where's Momo? Let me see the cat
Sleeping, can't even wake him up
Son, your dad absolutely refuses to go to the hospital
Dad, just go get a check-up, think of it as accompanying Mom
He says he'll listen to you
Your dad is going for a physical exam tomorrow
Your dad's back, said they drew three tubes of blood
Your dad's checkup results are out
Blood pressure's a bit high, doctor says to watch it
Said he needs meds to control it, and to eat less salty stuff
Your dad's still stubborn, says he's fine
I took away all his pickles
Your dad took his meds today, pretty cooperative
That's good, keep an eye on him
You're out there alone, Mom can't help much
Today at the market I saw the candied lotus root you loved as a kid
Bought some, too bad you can't eat it
I'll eat it when I get back
You always say you'll come back, how many times now
Your dad measures his blood pressure every morning now, writes it in a notebook
He straightened up after I scolded him once
[link] List of dietary taboos for high blood pressure patients
You should read it too, use less salt when cooking
I don't have high blood pressure
Son, the square dance team has a competition coming up
Take it easy, don't overdo it
Don't worry, I know my limits
You said that last time too
By the way, coming back this weekend? Just for a meal
Son, which next week are you talking about
The week after next, it's settled
What's the date today, do you remember what you said?
I remember, coming back the week after next
Which week after next, you said that last week
Do the math, don't fool me
Let me check, should be next Saturday
Okay, I'll take that as for real
I won't talk to you anymore
Son, your dad's blood pressure came down today
The doctor said it's under control pretty well
Just that he has to keep taking the meds
The meds cost quite a bit each month
Don't worry about the money, I'll handle it
No need, Mom has a pension
Then Mom will keep track for now, next time I'll make you something tasty 🙂
Son, don't forget about coming back this weekend
What do you want to eat? I'll prepare ahead
Okay, I'll make them all for you
Your dad says he wants to show off his skills and cook a fish
Yep, I bought a ticket for Saturday morning 👍
What time do you arrive? I'll pick you up at the station
No need to pick me up, I'll go back myself
Okay, then I'll wait for you at the community gate at nine
I said no need to wait
Your dad already bought the fish, it's in the freezer
Son, when you come back tomorrow don't forget to bring a thick jacket
It's chilly here in Nanjing morning and evening
I asked a colleague to do it
Son, have you packed your things?
Go to bed early, don't miss the train tomorrow
Son, are you on the train?
Good, I'm heading to the community gate now
It's only 8:50 now, I won't arrive until 9
You didn't sit around much when you came back yesterday
Well, I had to rush back to take care of the cat
Son, after you left yesterday, I was tidying up the room
Looking at the blanket you slept in, I felt a bit empty inside
Eat well when you get back 🙂
Your dad says come back and stay a couple more days next time
Yeah, as soon as I opened the door it jumped on me
That's good, I was worried it'd forget you
Go to bed early, work tomorrow
It's cooled down in Nanjing today, is it cold where you are?
Did you read that foot soak article I sent you🌹
Then why such a half-hearted reply
Your dad checked his blood pressure yesterday, it's a bit high
I didn't dare say much, just told him to stop drinking
Then he should go to the hospital for a checkup
I said the same, but he's stubborn
I'll take him this weekend, I'll take leave
Your dad heard you're coming back, he's thrilled
[Link] People with high blood pressure should avoid these vegetables
Son, take a look at this
Your grandma asked when you're getting married
I said no rush, she wasn't happy🤦
Son, drink a glass of warm water in the morning
I went dancing today, learned a new tune
So tired, my back feels a bit off
It's fine, moving around is good
Your dad took his blood pressure medicine, it's been okay these two days
Takeout again... cooking yourself would be so much better
Has the heating come on in your rented place?
Where in the south is there heating😂
Oh right, then cover up more
Son, what are you up to?
Your dad had two eggs this morning, blood pressure went up again
I tell him but he won't listen
Eggs should be fine right, it's the salt
Anyway I'm keeping an eye on him
You stop staying up so late too
Send me a pic of Momo
Then take one of him sleeping
Son, Mom wants to tell you something
Auntie Wang's daughter, she's in Shanghai too, works as an accountant
She's really nice, want me to introduce you?
Mom no need, I've got it handled
Handled what, just bring someone home already
Whatever, Mom won't push, go eat
Your dad went for a checkup, doctor said it's under control
Told him to keep taking his meds
I moved that pot of roses on the balcony today
Is it cold, remember to turn on the AC
That place on the way isn't clean
Cook some noodles yourself when you get home, stop ordering takeout
That's fine too, get some rest
Made dumplings today, your dad loves fennel ones
Saved you a box, froze it
When are you coming to get it
Your dad's been coughing these two days, told him to drink pear water
Give us a call when you have time
Son, your dad went to get his physical report today
It's fine, I'll call and ask at noon
It's out, blood pressure a bit high, doctor prescribed meds
Said take them every day, can't stop
Then just take them, listen to the doctor
Your dad's not too happy, says meds hurt the body
You tell him, if he won't listen I'll talk to him
Your dad took it, said he'll listen to you.
Only our son has a way 😁
Good morning, did you take your medicine?
I'm not sick, why would I take medicine?
Oh, then you ask him yourself.
I tried, he just says I'm nagging.
Today's square dance competition, our team got second prize.
Son, did you do that health checkup?
You're almost 30, get checked once a year.
Don't be like your dad, wait till something's wrong.
Got it, I'll make an appointment.
Tell me the date when you book it.
A lot, all over the house.
Nice weather today, I sun-dried all the blankets.
You should sun-dry your blanket too.
Son, Mom wants to ask you something.
Just asking, Aunt Wang said, from your Moments.
Your dad went to the park to play chess today, he's in good spirits.
And takes his medicine on time.
I made yam porridge today, good for the stomach.
You should learn to make some too.
When do I have time to make porridge?
Cook at night, drink in the morning.
How many days of annual leave left at your company? Why save them?
About seven or eight days left.
Son, your dad and I discussed, come back earlier for New Year.
Can't you just set a date?
It's cold and rainy today, remember to bring an umbrella
I learned a new dance, let me show you a video
Son, did you book that physical exam?
Your dad said he wants to eat that braised duck from the place you brought last time
Bring another one when you come back
I know, I know, I won't nag
By the way, your grandma is in the hospital, minor issue, don't worry
Not serious, just staying a few days for observation
Give your grandma a call when you have time
Your grandma said she was so happy to get your call
Son, I'm going to the hospital to see your grandma today
Asked the doctor while I was there, what to watch out for at her age
The doctor said eat more soft food, less oil
I'll write these down and show your dad
Your grandma is out of the hospital, recovering well
Son, have you lost weight recently?
It's the weekend, what did you eat for lunch? 🌹
It's already ten, hurry up and eat
I took a photo of your box of dumplings, let me show you
Still frozen, waiting for you to come back
Go to bed early, don't play on your phone
It's raining pretty hard in Nanjing
I bought that blood pressure monitor and sent it to you
Measure yourself when you get it, you need to pay attention at your age too
Perfect, let me tell you something
Mom wants to talk to you seriously about something
Aunt Wang brought up her daughter again yesterday
I said my son has his own ideas, I don't interfere
Do you have a partner or not? Tell Mom the truth.
Where's she from? What does she do? How old?
Mom, you're asking so many at once
Okay okay, take your time, Mom's not rushing 😁
It's okay, I have a jacket
[Link] Never eat these four things together in winter
Son, your grandma is out of the hospital
Your dad's blood pressure has been stable these two days
Is he taking his meds on time?
He is, I'm keeping an eye on him
Just tore up the tissue box
Is the sun out where you are?
Son, went to square dance today
A new auntie joined the team, very lively
Your dad wants salty food again tonight, I said no
It's cold, it's cold, Nanjing is so cold today
Did you bring that thick down jacket back?
Good, don't tough it out with too few clothes
Son, let me ask you something
Just asking, feels like you've been slow to reply lately
If you don't want to say, forget it
Mom's not trying to control you
Oh, okay, if you're busy then focus
Son, did you eat this morning?
Even if you're in a hurry, you gotta eat, your stomach will go bad like this 🤗
[Link] People with bad stomachs should eat less of these
Son, your grandma wanted me to ask when you're coming back to visit
Bought a pot of orchids today
I was sleeping, Mom, phone was on silent
You scared me, thought something happened to you
Keep the sound on when you sleep from now on
Your dad's blood pressure was a bit high today
He snuck a couple sips of booze last night
Give him a talking-to too when you get a chance
Did you clip Momo's nails yet
No, she runs off the second I try
[Link] Ten things cat owners need to know
Son, help me with my phone
I don't know how to screenshot 😶
Son, what'd you have for breakfast today
How can you not eat, go buy something now
Is it raining where you are
It's been raining all morning in Nanjing
Yeah it's raining, didn't bring an umbrella
Are you soaked?! Go back and change clothes
It's fine, the office has AC
Son, drink more hot water, don't catch a cold
Then I'll mail you some brown sugar ginger tea tomorrow
Mailed the package, remember to pick it up
You're off today, what are you planning to do
Lying around is good, get some rest
I knitted you a scarf, I'll mail it over
Mom, your eyes aren't great, don't knit
It's fine, a little each day
The scarf's dark gray, goes with anything you wear
Mom wants to ask you something serious.
Why do you suddenly ask that?
Just a guess. You've been different lately.
Where's she from? What does she do?
She's from Shanghai, works in design.
When are you bringing her home for Mom to see?
Son, Mom didn't sleep well last night.
Thinking about whether you'll bring her home.
Then let me ask first: what does the girl like to eat?
Then I'll cook more dishes when the time comes.
Your dad's happy too. He ate half a bowl more rice at lunch.
He said don't rush, take it slow.
Son, does that girl know about our family situation?
Don't think Mom's being annoying. I just want to know more.
Son, any plans for the weekend?
Don't be on your phone all the time. Spend more time with her.
The weather's nice today. Go out for a walk.
I just went for a walk in the park.
Saw families out having fun. It was lively.
What did you have for lunch?
That friend, is it your partner?
Son, Mom forwarded you an article.
[Link] What young people should pay attention to when dating
Just take a look, it might not be right 🌹
Mom just doesn't want you to get hurt 👍
Your dad's asking: what's that girl's name?
From now on just call her Amy, stop saying 'your partner' all the time.
It's getting cold, tell Amy to keep warm too.
Son, the square dance team's having a get-together today 👍
The team leader brought her husband, they're such a sweet couple.
Your dad says when you two get married, he'll learn to dance too.
By the way, what do you want to eat on your birthday?
Son, when exactly is that health checkup scheduled?
Your dad needs a follow-up too, you promised.
Stop saying next month, give a specific date.
Alright, I'll set it in the next couple days.
Good, then you go with him, okay?
Then I'll tell your dad in advance.
Son, your dad says he wants to stroll around after his checkup that day.
Go shopping with him for a bit.
Have you decided on your annual leave? Come back early.
Son, Mom's asking: what date are you planning to come back for New Year?
Decide early so we can buy tickets.
Don't wait till the last minute and say there are no tickets.
It's cold today, wear thick clothes when you go out.
Mom's sunbathing on the balcony, the orchid bloomed two more flowers.
I'll show you when you come back.
What did you have for dinner?
Son, has your dad's follow-up results come out? 🤗
They're out, doctor says it's under control.
Son, are you busy these days?
Then take care, don't stay up too late.
Is it okay if Mom adds Amy on WeChat?
By the way, have you worn your scarf? It's cold.
Son, Mom wants to tell you something.
The 6th of next month is Mom's birthday.
Mom doesn't want anything else, just wants you to come back for a meal.
Okay, Mom will wait for your definite answer.
Made your favorite braised pork today, but you're not coming back.
I'll cook a whole table for you on your birthday.
Next month on the 6th, my birthday.
Even in a meeting, you can't just not reply.
Telling you in advance so I can book tickets.
[Link] What to eat for birthdays for middle-aged and elderly that's healthiest
When you come back, I'll stew ribs for you.
You said you'd ask these two days.
Asked, she said she'll add in a couple of days.
About Amy adding my WeChat, did you ask?
[Link] Don't drink cold water when you get up in the morning.
Take a look, it makes sense.
Read it, I'll drink warm water.
Where's Momo? Did you feed it?
Fed it, it ate before me.
The rose on my balcony bloomed.
It's blooming beautifully, a big one.
Impressive, you're good at growing flowers.
Of course, much better than you.
The rose on my balcony bloomed, it's so pretty.
Your dad's blood pressure this morning was 138.
Take a picture and show me.
Not bad, just take medicine on time.
I'll show you on video tonight, it's blooming big.
Yeah, make sure he takes it every day.
I'll make it myself, tomato and eggs.
Neighbor Aunt Zhang's daughter got married last month.
What do you want me to bring back? Mom will prepare it.
No need, I'll just grab something to eat
How can you do that? I'll pack you some salted duck
Okay okay, you do whatever you think
Mom, how's Dad's blood pressure these two days?
Measured this morning, 140, a bit high
Make him take his meds on time, don't let him keep forgetting
I watch him every day, don't worry
Mom, I bought some stuff and shipped it home
What did you buy? Wasting money again
For you and Dad, it'll arrive in a couple days
Okay okay, I'll keep it for you
Son, are you coming back on the 6th or not?
I need to book the restaurant
Are you coming back on the 6th or not? I need to book the restaurant
Come back and I'll make you pork ribs stew
Mom, which restaurant are we booking?
The one in Laomendong, your favorite
Okay, I'll give you a definite answer in a couple days

sessions.name: Tina
messages: Just got out of a meeting, what's up sis?
Momo tore another kid's drawing book at kindergarten yesterday
Teacher called the parents, like I have time to go
😂 Can't really blame Momo for that
Takes after me, got a temper
Mom and Dad had another fight yesterday
Over the TV remote, hilarious right
I tried to mediate for ages, exhausted
Thanks sis, I'll just stand by and laugh
It's the weekend sis, let me sleep a bit
Momo says she wants to video chat with you
Alright alright, let me wash my face
Momo just said uncle is really ugly
You're just gonna stay useless huh 🤗
I just finished a 5k run, feeling great
Dad called asking about the massage chair
Said neighbor old Zhang bought one
I saw one online for 6000, good reviews
Transfer me before end of the month, don't forget
What time can you rest, sis?
Momo insisted on wearing a dress to kindergarten this morning
It's below zero outside, I said no, she cried
Mom called today saying she misses Momo
Asked if we can go back for Spring Festival
Still early, let's finish year-end stuff first
By the way, are you still with that girlfriend?
Then treat her well, don't keep stringing her along
How am I stringing her along 😶
Drank too much coffee, feeling jittery.
Tina, you should drink less Americano.
Still have a meeting this afternoon, hang in there.
What are you up to at home this weekend?
Lying down, Momo is on my belly.
That cat is almost as lazy as you.
If you have the guts, say it to her face.
Let me tell you something. Doudou asked yesterday why uncle doesn't come to see me.
Come on, it's only an hour by high-speed rail.
Alright alright, I'll go back once next month.
I said it, I said it.
Just took Doudou to the park, she ran off twice.
Tina, can your heart take it?
Next time put a leash on her.
Are you busy? Help me look at a contract clause.
Send it to me, I'll look this afternoon.
Did you look at that contract?
Not yet, forgot because I was busy, will definitely look today.
Tina, I'll really look, don't be mad.
My client is pushing me here.
Done reading, there's a problem with the disclaimer clause on page three.
Did you see it? I think so too.
Doudou has a performance at kindergarten today, I took half a day off.
Yes, wait for me to send it to you.
I posted it on Moments, go give it a like.
Liked, liked, Doudou looks so pretty.
I'll definitely transfer by the end of the month.
Mom and Dad said they want to install a water heater, the old one keeps breaking.
I said I'll pay, don't worry about it.
Tina, why do you take everything on yourself?
The three thousand you transferred for the massage chair was helping me.
If Mom knew, she'd be happy all day.
Closed a case today, feeling relaxed.
Let's go grab a drink tonight to celebrate.
Just finished taking statements, out to pick up Doudou.
Exhausted, and Doudou sang all the way.
Revising the proposal, revising till I doubt life.
That's how it is with clients.
Client says the color isn't classy enough. What the heck does 'classy' even mean?
Oh right, when's the massage chair for Mom and Dad arriving?
When it arrives, I'll have them take a video.
Momo's asleep, I can finally breathe.
Tina, you should sleep early too.
Can sleep through the night tonight, thank god.
The massage chair arrives tomorrow, the guy said he'll come install it.
Mom and Dad will be thrilled.
You think they'll complain it takes up space?
Dad will complain but secretly love it.
Mom sat on it and won't get off.
Dad's waiting in line next to her 😂
Guess what time Tina worked overtime till today?
I know, just cases piled up.
Beijing cooled down over the weekend, remember Nanjing gets cold too.
When are you planning to bring Amy home to meet the family?
Still early? How long have you been together?
We're doing fine, what's the rush?
Not rushing, just want you to be aware.
Mom went to square dancing today, said she met a bunch of old sisters.
Good thing, she gets bored at home.
Just that she keeps complaining about leg pain when she comes back.
Momo put on her shoes by herself today, wore them backwards and still showed off.
Taking Momo to the zoo, want to video call and see?
Just saw the elephants, Momo said she wants to ride one.
Then you gotta ask the elephant if it agrees.
She took it seriously and went to tell the zookeeper.
Back now, exhausted, walked over ten thousand steps.
Had fun today, thanks uncle for video calling.
Nothing, just wanted you to look at that quote for me.
Done reviewing. Two items are overpriced.
Labor and shipping are clearly inflated.
Momo got infected by me too. Both of us lying at home.
Then you two drink more hot water.
Mom and Dad called to ask, I hid it from them.
Right, my mom hears I'm sick and she'd bring a truckload of meds.
Tell you something, I might have to go to Shanghai for business.
Then I'll treat you to a meal.
Momo asked me when uncle is coming to Beijing.
I said I'd go back, I remember.
Just grab something downstairs at the office.
What are you doing this weekend?
Lying at home, Momo sheds fur all over the house.
That's the fate of having a cat.
What are you up to today?
I'm taking Momo to an interest class, will video call you when we're back.
Just finished class, Momo drew a picture, says she wants to give it to uncle.
Then I must keep it well 😁
She says it's you, but I think it looks like a potato.
By the way, when are you going to transfer that three thousand for the massage chair? I've covered it for you.
Momo ate another kid's cookies at kindergarten today.
The teacher called me, I lost all face.
Like you, when you were little you snatched mine.
Got home at twelve last night.
Momo still awake, waiting for me.
Talk about what? The institute is like this.
Looks unhappy, complaining I didn't feed him canned food.
Mom called yesterday, said you haven't been home for two months.
No way, I just went back the month before last
What about your girlfriend? Still the same one?
Mom said the sofa at home is no good anymore
The kind you can't get up from once you sit down
I'm thinking of buying Mom and Dad a massage chair, what do you think?
Deal, I'll transfer you at the end of the month
It's your day off today, what are you up to?
For the massage chair order, should I use your name or mine?
Yours, I can't fill in my address properly
Okay, I'll place the order then
Was up again last night revising the contract until 1
No time, got a meeting later
Then don't stay up so late
By the way, what are you getting Dad for his birthday 👍
I'm thinking of buying Dad an electric shaver
Momo said today she misses her uncle
Not too bad, project is wrapping up
Then find time to come back to Beijing, Momo keeps talking about you
The massage chair can arrive today
